description: Find optimal whole-tone and half-step trill fingerings on the F/Bb double horn, identifying whether a trill should be executed as a mechanical valve trill or a harmonic lip trill (common above written E5 on the F side).

baseNote.description: Principal written note of the trill (e.g. "F#4", "G4", "A4", "B4", "C5", "D5")

interval.description: Trill interval above the principal note ("half-step" or "whole-step")

name: lookup_horn_trill_fingering
title: French Horn Valve Trill & Lip Trill Fingering Guide
